gpu_tip: ~33GB total at 128K context. An i-quant: smaller than the K-quants at the same bit width and imatrix-calibrated, at the cost of more CPU work per token for any layer that spills. An 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4060) plus ~32GB of DDR5 system RAM covers it; I-quants run best on CUDA/ROCm.
mac_tip: Needs ~33GB — fits a 48GB MacBook Pro comfortably; a 36GB M4 Max or M5 Max is tight.
